testimonials.text: It was a very useful and well-organized course. I especially appreciated the practical approach and the opportunity to strengthen my knowledge and skills in cesarean section procedures.
The interactive identification of surgical instruments was very helpful for clinical preparation.
This course was very interesting for me, because it's what I deal with almost every single day, it was wonderful.
The simplicity of teaching such complex surgery in a stressful situation is unmatched.
The instruments. I always wanted to know which one is for what. I am a medical school student myself. And it was my first time seeing them.
I love that it is an actual C-section video presentation.
